example.title: Jowler Creek Bridge, Interurban Road over Jowler Creek
example.place: Camden Point vicinity, Platte County, MO

brief: Two-span filled-spandrel reinforced-concrete arch of the Luten design, built 1912-13 for an electric interurban railway and later turned into a road: two flat segmental arches of 47.5 ft each (95 ft overall) on a central pier, 18.1 ft wide with a 16.4 ft roadway, 23 ft above a wooded creek bottom. Plain board-formed spandrel walls, projecting coping and low solid concrete parapets; striped hazard markers at the ends of a gravel road, farmstead nearby.
